claims.text: Grain refinement and texture optimization of HfZrTiTa0.53 will improve tensile ductility.
Grain refinement and texture optimization of HfZrTiTa0.53 will improve uniform elongation.
The intervention will maintain the alloy's strength.
The intervention will maintain impact-triggered energy release.
The initial HfZrTiTa0.53 material is in an as-processed state.
The proposed intervention is applicable at room temperature under tension and compression at strain rates from 10^-3 to 10^1 s^-1.
Grain-boundary and dislocation interactions are the structural mediator of the intervention's effects.
Grain refinement and texture optimization reduce stress concentrations.
Grain refinement and texture optimization enhance strain hardening.
Reduced stress concentrations and enhanced strain hardening preserve strength.
Tensile ductility will increase by at least 20% after the intervention.
Uniform elongation will increase by at least 15% after the intervention.
Yield strength after the intervention will remain above 786 MPa.
Compressive strength after the intervention will remain above 1314 MPa.
The reported baseline yield strength of HfZrTiTa0.53 is 786 MPa.
The reported baseline compressive strength of HfZrTiTa0.53 is 1314 MPa.
The reported baseline terminal strain of HfZrTiTa0.53 is 13.5%.

contradictions.description: The hypothesis confidently predicts preservation of impact-triggered energy release, but the stated applicability boundary covers only tension and compression, while performance under impact loading is explicitly identified as uncertain.

Preservation of impact-triggered energy release is part of the hypothesis, but the listed measurements contain no impact-energy or reaction metric and the falsification rule does not test failure to preserve energetic performance.

Percentage improvements are specified for tensile ductility and uniform elongation, but the baseline provides only terminal strain and does not identify a baseline tensile ductility or uniform elongation from which those percentages can be calculated.
